name: c-stepper-1
title: Basic stepper
label: Basic
description: Basic stepper

guidance.bestFor: A row of 4 numbered circles, uncontrolled, whose connector takes the primary color after each passed step

whenNotToUse.when: Steps driven from your own state with Previous and Next buttons below

name: c-stepper-2
title: Stepper with completed state
label: Completed State
description: Stepper with completed state

guidance.bestFor: Passed steps painted green on both the circle and its connector, with later numbers in gray

whenNotToUse.when: Steps marked by rings rather than numbers, with a spinner on the busy one

name: c-stepper-3
title: Stepper with loading state
label: Loading State
description: Stepper with loading state

guidance.bestFor: Number free ring markers: a dot marks the current step, a spinner the loading one and a check each passed step
agentNotes: `loading` is hard coded to step 2; set it from your request state so the spinner stops when the work ends

whenNotToUse.when: The same spinning busy step on a column that runs top to bottom

name: c-stepper-4
title: Controlled stepper
label: Controlled
description: Controlled stepper

guidance.bestFor: The active step kept in React state and moved by Previous and Next buttons that disable at either end

whenNotToUse.when: Step position kept inside the component, with no buttons to move it

name: c-stepper-5
title: Stepper with title and indicator
label: Labels Below
description: Stepper with title and indicator

guidance.bestFor: Numbered circles that become checks once passed, each with a short label centered below it

whenNotToUse.when: Labels that also need a line of helper text under each title

name: c-stepper-6
title: Stepper with progress bar indicator
label: Left Aligned Titles
description: Stepper with progress bar indicator

guidance.bestFor: Left aligned numbers over bold titles from User Details to Preview Form, with no lines between steps

whenNotToUse.when: Thin bars in place of numbered circles above each title

name: c-stepper-7
title: Stepper with icons and badges
label: Icons & Badges
description: Stepper with icons and badges

guidance.bestFor: Icon circles above a Step N eyebrow, a bold title and an In Progress, Completed or Pending badge

name: c-stepper-8
title: Stepper with descriptions
label: Descriptions
description: Stepper with descriptions

guidance.bestFor: Centered steps stacking a number, a title and a one line description, with connectors between them

whenNotToUse.when: A title and a description stacked to the side of each number

name: c-stepper-9
title: Stepper with inline titles
label: Inline Titles
description: Stepper with inline titles

guidance.bestFor: A number or check beside each title in one row, with a connector that fills once the step is passed

whenNotToUse.when: Titles stacked under each number rather than beside it

name: c-stepper-10
title: Stepper with content for each step
label: Title & Caption
description: Stepper with content for each step

guidance.bestFor: A number or check beside a 2 line title and caption per step, joined by muted connectors that never fill
agentNotes: `steps` holds placeholder titles such as Step 1 and a bare Description caption; swap in your own copy

whenNotToUse.when: Inline steps that carry a title alone, without a caption

name: c-stepper-11
title: Stepper with progress bar and titles
label: Bar With Titles
description: Stepper with progress bar and titles

guidance.bestFor: Full width bar segments, one per step, filling with the primary color up to the current one, titles below

whenNotToUse.when: One joined bar with a counter and Back and Next controls

name: c-stepper-12
title: Stepper with segmented progress bar
label: Segmented Bar
description: Stepper with segmented progress bar

guidance.bestFor: One thick bar of 4 joined segments, a Back link, a current of total counter and a Next button

whenNotToUse.when: Separate bars that each carry the step title underneath

name: c-stepper-13
title: Stepper with vertical orientation and descriptions
label: Vertical Descriptions
description: Stepper with vertical orientation and descriptions

guidance.bestFor: A top to bottom column of numbered markers, each with a title and a description beside it, links greening once done

whenNotToUse.when: A column that names each step with a title only

name: c-stepper-14
title: Stepper with vertical orientation
label: Vertical
description: Stepper with vertical orientation

guidance.bestFor: A bare column of 3 numbered circles with green links between finished ones and a spinner on the loading step
agentNotes: Step 2 always carries `loading`, so it spins whenever it is active; tie the flag to real work in progress

whenNotToUse.when: Each step in the column needs a name and a short description

name: c-stepper-15
title: Stepper with vertical orientation and titles
label: Vertical Titles
description: Stepper with vertical orientation and titles

guidance.bestFor: Vertical numbered steps labelled with one title each and no supporting text, content centered below

whenNotToUse.when: Steps in a horizontal row across the top of the content

name: c-stepper-16
title: Stepper with delivery stops and ETAs
label: Delivery Stops
description: A vertical rail of 5 delivery addresses joined by dotted connectors, an On time badge on the current stop and arrival times on hover.

guidance.bestFor: A route list that moves beside its stop detail in wider containers, a spinner on the current stop, Previous and Next
agentNotes: The current stop always reads On time; derive `status` from real arrival data rather than the step position

whenNotToUse.when: A delivery run laid out across the page with details under each stage

name: c-stepper-17
title: Stepper with dotted progress
label: Dotted Progress
description: 5 label-free dots for a workspace setup flow, with the step count, name and hint of the selected step shown below.

guidance.bestFor: Tiny ring dots joined by dotted links in a box at most 240px wide, each named only by its aria label

whenNotToUse.when: A survey that asks one question per screen and keeps the answers

name: c-stepper-18
title: Stepper with key-value stage details
label: Stage Details
description: 5 delivery run stages from loading to return, each with a time and dashed-leader rows such as gate, delay, ETA and battery.

guidance.bestFor: A stage row that turns into a draggable carousel with faded edges when it overflows, each stage listing label and value pairs
agentNotes: The agent photo in `stages` is a hot linked Unsplash URL; swap `avatar` for an image you host

whenNotToUse.when: A sea freight route whose ports show carrier, voyage and dates

name: c-stepper-19
title: Stepper with icon tiles in a frame
label: Frame Icon Tiles
description: 3 resolution steps in a framed header bar with check or dashed ring tiles and subtitles, collapsing to tiles alone when narrow.

guidance.bestFor: A muted Frame header strip with arrows between steps above an empty placeholder panel and Previous and Next
agentNotes: Every panel renders only the `empty` placeholder text inside `Empty`; put the step's real content there

whenNotToUse.when: Icon tiles per step joined by chevrons, outside any header strip

name: c-stepper-20
title: Stepper with purchase order checks
label: Purchase Orders
description: 6 purchase orders that expand into 3-way match checks, each passed, failed with an issue count, or pending, with payment links under More.

guidance.bestFor: A Tree of orders with Ready or Review badges and an actions menu on the active step row, also opened by Shift+F10
agentNotes: Built on the `Tree` primitive with `useTree` from `@headless-tree/react`, so it renders no Stepper parts at all
The `DropdownMenuItem` actions and the More rows in `links` have no handlers yet; route `links` from `onPrimaryAction`, which skips them now
Swap `orders` for your data; badges and step states are derived from each order's `checks`

whenNotToUse.when: A plain folder outline with no pass, fail or pending result per row

name: c-stepper-21
title: Stepper with grouped security checks
label: Security Checks
description: 29 security checks under 12 numbered steps in 4 areas, with finding counts and severity badges, and Previous and Next closing the branch they leave.

guidance.bestFor: A 3 level Tree of areas, numbered steps and checks, whose row status follows where the active check sits
agentNotes: Runs on `useTree` and the `Tree` primitive rather than on Stepper, and needs `@headless-tree/core`
Replace `areas`: counts and severities are sample findings, and every string leaf becomes one check

whenNotToUse.when: Nested folders or files browsed with no current check to move through

name: c-stepper-22
title: Stepper with color-coded bottom bars
label: Bottom Color Bars
description: 4 billing setup steps as colored bars along the panel's bottom edge, the active one thicker, under the current step's icon, name and hint.

guidance.bestFor: Step tabs pinned under the content as a footer strip, each in its own color, shortening to numbers when narrow

whenNotToUse.when: Color bars along the top edge above a card drawing

name: c-stepper-23
title: Stepper with top color bars and card art
label: Top Color Bars
description: Adding a payment card in 4 steps, each tab with its own color bar on the top edge that thickens when selected, over a card drawing and a caption.

guidance.bestFor: Colored tabs across the top of a Frame panel over static card artwork, for a card entry flow with no fields yet
agentNotes: `CardIllustration` is static and each step shows only its `caption`, so add the card form fields yourself

whenNotToUse.when: Bars that sit along the bottom edge under the step content

name: c-stepper-24
title: Stepper with icon tile rows
label: Icon Tile Rows
description: 4 incident resolution steps in a vertical list, each row showing an icon, a title, a subtitle and its status, above the selected step's detail line.

guidance.bestFor: Stacked Frame rows clickable edge to edge, each with an IconTile and a status marker at its end, above a Step N of 4 detail

whenNotToUse.when: A static list of glyph rows with no current position to move through

name: c-stepper-25
title: Stepper with phase track
label: Phase Track
description: A refund case in 4 phases labeled Phase 1 to 4, joined by a single track with a dot per phase and slash dividers, above the selected phase's summary.

guidance.bestFor: A pale track where only the current phase's slice fills blue, with a spinning dashed dot and refund case copy below

whenNotToUse.when: Each stop on the track needs the time it was reached above it

name: c-stepper-26
title: Stepper with timestamped checkpoints
label: Timestamped Checkpoints
description: Shipment tracking across 4 stops from loading to delivery, with the time each stop was reached above a dot on a shared track and a summary per stop.

guidance.bestFor: A muted track whose current slice fills with the foreground color, and times shown only for reached checkpoints
agentNotes: A checkpoint's `time` appears once it is at or before the selected step; drive it from real scan data

whenNotToUse.when: Upcoming stops that need an estimate and an arrow drawn into the next stop
A read only shipment history with no stop to select or move between

name: c-stepper-27
title: Stepper with transit arrow
label: Transit Arrow
description: 4-stop freight route with times, Est. and ETA labels and a ticked track where an arrow leads toward the current stop, plus a summary per stop.

guidance.bestFor: Times on passed stops and estimates for the rest, over tick marks with an arrow drawn into the selected stop

whenNotToUse.when: A plain track that shows reached times only, with no arrow

name: c-stepper-28
title: Stepper with breadcrumb steps
label: Breadcrumb Steps
description: 5-step new hire onboarding shown as step names split by chevrons, with a step counter, a 5-segment bar and the selected step's summary below.

guidance.bestFor: Text only step names beside an Onboarding label and a step counter, dropping to a row of their own below 48rem

whenNotToUse.when: Small status dots with blue connectors beside each step name

name: c-stepper-29
title: Stepper with compact inline progress
label: Compact Inline
description: 5 new hire onboarding steps in a single row of small status dots and names, with connectors that turn blue as steps finish and a summary below.

guidance.bestFor: A row of dashed rings and names that keeps only the current name when narrow, the current ring spinning and done ones blue

whenNotToUse.when: Step names alone split by chevrons, with a counter and a segment bar

name: c-stepper-30
title: Stepper with truck route and rest stops
label: Truck Route
description: 7 stops on a 2,890 km truck run from Memphis to Los Angeles, with dashed legs, 8H rest badges and a truck on the leg in progress.

guidance.bestFor: Icon stops in rings with short fixed legs for rest breaks and a green destination once it is selected
agentNotes: A stop with `rest` gets a fixed 32px leg that shows that value as a badge; leave it off ordinary driving stops

whenNotToUse.when: Sea legs between ports with carrier, voyage and progress per leg

name: c-stepper-31
title: Stepper with icon tiles and chevrons
label: Chevron Icon Tiles
description: 4 incident resolution steps, each a tinted icon tile with its title and step number, joined by chevrons, with the step's detail below.

guidance.bestFor: A row of IconTile steps split by chevron icons, with the focus ring drawn on the tile, folding to bare tiles when narrow

whenNotToUse.when: Interlocking arrow shapes with a filled current stage

name: c-stepper-32
title: Stepper with numbered chevron stages
label: Numbered Chevrons
description: 7 sales pipeline stages from Lead to Approval as a bar of interlocking arrows, each with a numbered keycap and the current stage filled blue.

guidance.bestFor: Clip path chevrons that nest notch into arrow, outlined by a drop shadow on focus because the clip hides the ring

whenNotToUse.when: A deal board where every stage column holds many cards that move

name: c-stepper-33
title: Stepper with filled status chevrons
label: Filled Chevrons
description: 8 proposal steps as nested arrows in a frame, green with a check once finished, solid blue with a spinner when current and dashed rings ahead.

guidance.bestFor: An inverse Frame strip of chevrons that hug their labels with no done count, folding to icons around the current step

whenNotToUse.when: A Plan done count chip ahead of chevrons that share the full width

name: c-stepper-34
title: Stepper with outlined chevron plan
label: Outlined Chevrons
description: 6 proposal steps as nested arrows after a done count, finished ones outlined in green with a check and the current one in blue with a spinner.

guidance.bestFor: Full width chevrons whose traced SVG edges outline the done and current steps at low opacity, after a Plan count chip

whenNotToUse.when: Flat chevrons with no outline, where finished steps just turn a darker gray

name: c-stepper-35
title: Stepper with flat chevron plan
label: Flat Chevrons
description: 6 contract steps as borderless arrows after a done count, finished ones in darker gray with a check and the current one tinted blue with a spinner.

guidance.bestFor: Chevrons clipped on the trigger itself, with an inner pill that draws the focus ring, for a contract plan

whenNotToUse.when: Solid filled chevrons that turn green when done and hug their labels

name: c-stepper-36
title: Stepper with shipping route and stop details
label: Shipping Route
description: 5 ports from Singapore to Hamburg, each with carrier, voyage and dates over dashed leaders, and a wave marking the leg in progress.

guidance.bestFor: A container query route that sheds rows as it narrows, a skewed segment bar on one leg and an arrow past the last port
agentNotes: The sailed share in `wave` is fixed at 75%; compute it from the real distance of the active leg
The captain photo is an Unsplash URL in `avatar`; replace it with an image you serve

whenNotToUse.when: A truck run with rest breaks and a vehicle badge on the moving leg

name: c-stepper-37
title: Stepper with horizontal step cards
label: Horizontal Step Cards
description: 4 incident rollback steps as clickable icon cards that wrap to 2 columns when narrow, with a corner check on done cards and the step detail below.

guidance.bestFor: Cards that are the tabs themselves via a FramePanel render, in a 2 or 4 column grid above the detail

whenNotToUse.when: Cards stacked in a column with the detail beside them

name: c-stepper-38
title: Stepper with shipment progress bar
label: Shipment Progress
description: Order tracking across 6 stages from placed to delivered, with a green plane badge on the current stage and a dashed track that fills green behind it.

guidance.bestFor: Icon labels under a tick track that turns solid green when passed, folding to evenly spaced bare icons when narrow

whenNotToUse.when: Stops with exact and estimated times and an arrow into the current one

name: c-stepper-39
title: Stepper with vertical step cards
label: Vertical Step Cards
description: 4 incident rollback steps as stacked icon cards beside the step detail, done cards tinted green with a corner check, plus Previous and Next.

guidance.bestFor: Stacked tab cards in a 240px column with useId scoped ids, the detail moving under them below 28rem

whenNotToUse.when: Cards laid out in a grid across the top with the detail below

name: c-stepper-40
title: Stepper with side rail and step icons
label: Side Rail Icons
description: 6 incident response steps as rows with their own icons, a blue bar on the current row, green checks on done rows and the step detail beside them.

guidance.bestFor: A glyph of its own per row that turns blue when selected, and a solid green check only at the end of finished rows

whenNotToUse.when: Rows that lead with a check, a spinning ring or a dashed circle rather than a step icon

name: c-stepper-41
title: Stepper with status list
label: Status List
description: 6 incident response steps with a status glyph per row: a check when done, a spinning ring on the current step and a dashed circle for the rest.

guidance.bestFor: A 180px rail whose current title turns blue, with a spinning ring that follows the selection and useId scoped ids

whenNotToUse.when: Thin vertical bars on each row in place of round status glyphs

name: c-stepper-42
title: Stepper with vertical status bars
label: Vertical Status Bars
description: 5 incident resolution steps, each marked by a thin vertical bar that is gray, green when done or dashed blue while current, with the detail beside.

guidance.bestFor: A bar per row that splits into 4 dashes on the current step, with the focus ring moved onto the label clear of it

whenNotToUse.when: Rows that each open with a check mark, a spinner or a dashed circle

name: c-stepper-43
title: Stepper with sub-steps in a collapsible card
label: Collapsible Sub-Steps
description: 5 ticket resolution phases holding 17 tasks, where the open phase lists its task status in a bordered box and folds away when clicked again.

guidance.bestFor: Numbered phases with a turning chevron, the open one boxed in a Frame that folds when picked again, its live task on a blue edge bar
agentNotes: Picking the current phase again folds it, since `selectPhase` toggles `open` when the step repeats
`onKeyUp` cancels Space on the phase trigger so Firefox does not act twice on one press; keep it

whenNotToUse.when: Phases on a right aligned rail where only the current one unfolds

name: c-stepper-44
title: Stepper with right-aligned sub-steps
label: Right-Aligned Sub-Steps
description: 5 ticket resolution phases on a vertical rail, only the current one unfolding its tasks, while Previous and Next walk all 17 tasks in order.

guidance.bestFor: End aligned labels on a segmented rail with a nested task rail, and status announced through useStepItem
agentNotes: `selectPhase` ignores the current phase, so choosing it again never resets the task in progress

whenNotToUse.when: A bordered box around the open phase that folds when chosen again
